title: Bullet train to Tokyo: Tenma sushi, Rainbow fireworks, Shinjuku all night

stops.name: Check out of Kujō House
stops.plan: Out by 10:00 with overnight bags only; the suitcases went to Garfield House by TA-Q-BIN yesterday.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line Kujō → Nishikujō, JR Osaka Loop line → Tenma, walk to the arcade; about 32 min door to door

stops.name: Harukoma Sushi (main store)
stops.plan: Queue from about 10:30 for the 11:00 opening: big, fresh nigiri at local prices in the Tenjinbashisuji arcade; counter seats, so sit in smaller groups and keep it to 40 min.
stops.transport: Walk to JR Tenma, Osaka Loop line → Osaka, JR Kyoto line → Shin-Osaka; about 36 min door to door, then ekiben and board

stops.name: Nozomi Shinkansen Shin-Osaka → Tokyo
stops.plan: Reserved seats for all 8 together on a Nozomi around 12:30; grab ekiben at Shin-Osaka as a snack on board.
stops.transport: Walk 6 min inside Tokyo Station to First Avenue B1

stops.name: Tokyo Character Street & Tokyo Okashi Land
stops.plan: A fast 30-minute pass for Tokyo-Station-only Pokémon, Sanrio, Ghibli and Jump goods and the Glico/Calbee snack shops.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi line Tokyo → Shinjuku-gyoemmae (16 min), walk; about 45 min door to door

stops.name: Check in to Garfield House
stops.plan: Check in (from 16:00) and drop the overnight bags; confirm the suitcases sent from Osaka arrive this evening. Leave again by 17:30.
stops.transport: Metro Marunouchi line Shinjuku-gyoemmae → Akasaka-mitsuke, Ginza line → Shimbashi, Yurikamome → Odaiba-kaihinkoen; about 68 min door to door

stops.name: Odaiba Rainbow Fireworks
stops.plan: Be on Odaiba Seaside Park beach by 18:40: five minutes of fireworks over the bay with Rainbow Bridge lit behind.
stops.transport: Rinkai line Tokyo Teleport → Osaki, JR Saikyo line rapid → Shinjuku, walk 3 min from the West Exit; about 51 min door to door

stops.name: Omoide Yokocho – Torien
stops.plan: Booked table for 8 in the smoky Showa alley: skewers and beers straight off the train from Odaiba.
stops.transport: Walk 7 min under the tracks to Kabukicho

stops.name: Shinjuku Kabuki Hall
stops.plan: Neon food-festival hall: everyone orders from different stalls, one big shared table, pre-game with DJs before the club upstairs.
stops.transport: Lifts up inside Tokyu Kabukicho Tower; doors 23:00

stops.name: ZEROTOKYO – NEON STARS
stops.plan: Saturday NEON STARS (bass, open format, techno) at Tokyo's biggest club; original passports, no sandals or sports pants.

stops.name: Sugoi Niboshi Ramen Nagi Golden Gai
stops.plan: 24-hour sardine ramen up the stairs in Golden Gai; 10 seats, so eat in two shifts.
stops.transport: Walk 8 min home to Garfield House
